params.body:
## Why

A source page names its publisher in words only and looks the same for every source. The icon of the publisher's site shows at a glance whose page is about to open.

## What

- Above the title of a source page: the icon of the publisher's site, 40 by 40. A site without a usable icon leaves no gap and no broken picture.
- `App\Sources\IconFetcher` reads the site's home page for the icon it names (the home screen icon first, then the largest), and tries `/favicon.ico` after that.
- `App\Sources\SourceIcons` fills them at the end of the cited sources sync, five sites a run, one icon per site in a new `source_icons` table. A site that gave none is asked again after 30 days. A failure here never fails the sync.
- `GET /sources/{key}/icon` serves our copy. The page does not load anything from the publisher, so opening it does not announce the reader there.

## Safety

The addresses come from lists of cited sources, so the server asks sites nobody here chose.

- https on the standard port only, a name and not a bare address, and every IPv4 address of that name must be public.
- The address that was checked is pinned for the connection, so a name that answers differently the second time leads nowhere else.
- Redirects are followed by hand, at most three, each checked the same way.
- Kept only when the first bytes are PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or ICO and the file is at most 300 KB. SVG is refused: it can carry script and would be served from our name. Served with the kind that was checked and `nosniff`.

## Checked

- `SourceIconTest`, 5 cases: the named icon is kept and shown; only a picture is kept; a site without one is not asked again for a month; an address inside the network is never asked, also not after a redirect; one icon for every source of a site.
- The fetcher tried on fifteen real sites from the workbench: fourteen gave an icon, most within 0.3 seconds, the slowest 1.5. Ofcom gave none.
- A source page opened locally with a real icon.
- Full suite 677 of 678; the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which needs a git folder the worktree does not have.

## After merge

The migration runs with the deploy. The icons arrive by themselves, five sites every sync.
params.title: A source page shows the icon of the publisher's site
